Name: CP Lemonade Dispenser
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Here is a functioning lemonade/tea dispenser! Now you're able to craft lemonades & tea! 

Has 9 total colors you can change using[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] Alternative Textures

[/url]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24121]CP Lemon and Lime Trees[/url] to make your drinks. 

Adds items and a crafting station to make lemonade and tea (Includes 15 drinks). You can buy the dispense machine from Pierre's shop and also if you don't wanna grow lemons or limes you can buy them from Pierre's as well.

Adds a default Lemon Bar recipe you can make as well. 

[spoiler] Lemonades/Limeades can be made lemons, limes, cherries, blueberries, oranges, strawberries,  and salmonberries!

Teas can be made from tea leaves, sugar, wild plum, dandelion, peaches, and blackberries you can also make instant coffee with coffee beans

Lemonade + Iced Tea = Arnold Palmer

**The main fruit put in is what star quality that you get out star quality fruit + lemon/lime/tealeaves = star quality iced drink**[/spoiler]

Make your own lemonade & tea with the dispenser! And sell to npcs with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309]Market Town[/url]!

To craft the items with lemons or limes you can buy them from the Pierre's shop or buy the lemon and lime saplings added in mod and grow the fruit trees yourself!

You can buy the dispenser from the shop and produce your own  lemonade, limeade, coffee or tea. Also there is a deco dispenser for you to place on tables or as decor has no function

You can buy the dispenser from the shop and produce your own  lemonade, limeade, iced coffee or tea. 

no plans as for no to make it compatible with Cornucopia lemons & limes
